differences: The paper recruited 47 right-handed participants (mean age 22.45, SD 3.39, 28 females); the deposit has trial data for 44, so the participant table cannot reproduce those numbers and they are not used as checks. The success rates are computed over all non-outlier trials of the 42 analysed participants; the deposit's data were not re-filtered otherwise. Trials the authors removed by hand when building bapdata (7 trials in 5 participants) are kept here.
